request.query: There exist positive natural degrees r_j greater than 10/delta with r_j log q_j balanced within factor 1+delta/10 and r_(j+1)/delta < r_j.

items.name: Polynomial.exists_partition_polynomial_aux
items.type:
∀ {Fq : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Fq] [inst_1 : Field Fq] (n : ℕ) {ε : ℝ},
  0 < ε →
    ∀ {b : Polynomial Fq},
      b ≠ 0 →
        ∀ (A : Fin n → Polynomial Fq),
          ∃ t,
            ∀ (i₀ i₁ : Fin n),
              t i₀ = t i₁ ↔ ↑(Polynomial.cardPowDegree (A i₁ % b - A i₀ % b)) < Polynomial.cardPowDegree b • ε

items.name: Polynomial.natDegree_pos_iff_degree_pos
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {p : Polynomial R}, 0 < p.natDegree ↔ 0 < p.degree

items.name: Ordnode.balancedSz_down
items.type: ∀ {l r₁ r₂ : ℕ}, r₁ ≤ r₂ → l + r₂ ≤ 1 ∨ l ≤ Ordnode.delta * r₁ → Ordnode.BalancedSz l r₂ → Ordnode.BalancedSz l r₁

items.name: Polynomial.degree_lt_degree
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {p q : Polynomial R}, p.natDegree < q.natDegree → p.degree < q.degree

items.name: Polynomial.natDegree_le_natDegree
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [inst : Semiring R] {p : Polynomial R} [inst_1 : Semiring S] {q : Polynomial S},
  p.degree ≤ q.degree → p.natDegree ≤ q.natDegree

items.name: Polynomial.natDegree_lt_natDegree
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : Semiring S] {p : Polynomial R} {q : Polynomial S},
  p ≠ 0 → p.degree < q.degree → p.natDegree < q.natDegree

items.name: Ordnode.balancedSz_up
items.type: ∀ {l r₁ r₂ : ℕ}, r₁ ≤ r₂ → l + r₂ ≤ 1 ∨ r₂ ≤ Ordnode.delta * l → Ordnode.BalancedSz l r₁ → Ordnode.BalancedSz l r₂

items.name: Polynomial.natDegree_le_of_dvd
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] [NoZeroDivisors R] {p q : Polynomial R}, p ∣ q → q ≠ 0 → p.natDegree ≤ q.natDegree
